reviews.text: Played the original release when it was a paid app, before it was removed and eventually taken over by the free to play version, and this does a great job replicating that original experience, but with extra improvements and a whole infinite rogue-like mode on top. I'm very glad I finally get to replay a version of the game like this again. Scrolling around both menus and the tower can feel a little off with mouse clicking only, but it's clearly a hold over from it's origins as a mobile game and the actual game itself is still a lot of fun.

If you're looking for a really underrated tower defense game, or just a tower defense game with a sense of humor then THIS (castle doombad) is a game for you! IT'S AWESOME AND STILL GETTING SUPPORT BY A SMALL COMPANY PLEASE TAKE A LOOK AT IT.

跟手机端的并没有什么区别，让人很失望：依旧是少得可怜的过关金币，让人想要尝试多几种陷阱都无法做到。如此匮乏的游戏内容，还不让人爽一些
非常很喜欢游戏的Q版画风，角色和场景设计都充满了可爱的元素，色彩搭配也十分清新。我个人觉得游戏也存在一些小瑕疵。在陷阱解锁方面，所有陷阱都需要靠金币才能解锁，但问题是每种陷阱的效果仅有简单的文字描述，没有直观的动画演示，导致到了选择解锁的时候会出现一定的选择困难。游戏目前已经有汉化，但汉化的有点不完全，但不影响游玩，总体来说是款非常不错的游戏，很值得一试

It's such a happy coincidence to find this game on Steam and discover it's still actively being updated. This is a truly unique and creative "tower" defense game, with a fun and relaxing theme and art style. Some levels are bit too tough, but the overall gameplay experience is excellent. Over the past 12 years, tons of new content have been added, and I especially love the new decoration system that provides gameplay bonuses. The only downside is that the Summer Slaycation outfits seem to have been replaced by the new features.

This game is absolutely peak, played it when I was a kid and discovered yesterday that this game is actually on Steam. Like the title says this game is a classic, it´s a lot of fun trying out different traps and strategies to keep them knights off of your princess. Compared to when I played like 6 years ago this game got a bunch of new updates like traps, a rogue mode and even decorations which work as passive upgrades which is really cool to see. So overall a really fun tower defense that I´d glady spend my money on just for the pure joy it brought be during my childhood...

I missed not having the mobile version all these years. Glad to be able to play it again, and it's great that there's been some touch-ups to keep everything fresh. The Roguevenge mode is a nice challenge and a good way to grind currency, which is still pretty heavily needed, and I was instantly hooked on there being new traps like the Mario-esque fire bar. Loving all the references here and there. The control room decorations and drip are also a welcome way to add some style and encourage you to diversify your strategies since the currency for it is temporarily frozen on traps you use enough. Dr. Lord Evilstein commands me to play? I obey!
